Card Q&A.q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP until the end of their turn" effect and the "1 of their Digimon gains  until the end of their turn" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP until the end of their turn. If you have 3 or fewer, 1 of their Digimon gains ＜Security A. -2＞ until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
